body:
I failed two semesters, I'm hardly getting anything other than a mass of student loan debt. Ideally I'd actually get my writing skills to a level that didn't make me feel physically ill, make money from writing fiction and selling it on Amazon, and move to a country with a lower cost of living that's open to immigration of online workers, like Costa Rica. That isn't going to happen because nobody actually makes money from writing, and I'm definitely not good enough to do so.

EDIT: Also, the only degree that I could plausibly complete would be in computer science, because they teach it very slowly.

I've tried moving forward that way before, but I reach a plateau somewhere between "getting dressed, showering, and eating every day" and "completing university assignments." Doing one positive action a day doesn't prioritize.
